```{r, setup}
#| echo: FALSE

#1.2 Loading packages 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggeffects)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)
library(gt)
library(AER)

#1.3 Loading the dataset
data(NMES1988)
data <- NMES1988

##CREATE TABLE OF VALUES 

#Selecting variables from dataset
chosen_data <- data|>
  select(visits,
         chronic,
         health,
         gender, 
         school,
         insurance)

#Assign a reference group 
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    health = fct_relevel(factor(health), "average"),
    gender = fct_relevel(factor(gender), "male")
  )
```


```{r, variable table}
#| tbl-cap: "Variable Description Table"

variable_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("visits", "chronic", "health", "gender", "school", "Insurance"), 
  Descprtion = c(
    "Number of physician office visits",
    "Number of chronic conditions",
    "Self-perceived health (poor, average, excellent"), 
  "Male or Female",
  "Years of education", 
  "Covered by private insurance",
  Role = c("Outcome",
           "Predictor",
           "Predictor",
           "Predictor",
           "Predictor",
           "Predictor"))
```
